purpose: Repaired source-level VCO post-layout transient and coupling-capacitance sensitivity cross-check.

source_changes.change: Replace emitted zero-ohm terminal-attachment RPEX edges with a configured numerical floor and record it in the topology ledger.
Declare terminal_attachment_resistance_ohm=1e-6 with explicit non-physical numerical-floor basis.

numerical_repair.floor_source: extractor default for the archived no-lateral snapshot; the checked-in model-configured path was independently verified

reverse_inference_status.supported_claim: The repaired deck supports bounded engineering sensitivity of simulated oscillation frequency to selected CPEX coupling factors.
reverse_inference_status.blocked_claim: The simulated frequency cannot uniquely identify silicon coupling, device, or foundry-RCX parameters.
blocking_evidence: The RCX and no-lateral model are engineering estimates rather than foundry-qualified extraction.
Compact-model ownership and analog LVS-clean VCO views are not silicon calibrated.
The cross-check changes only selected CPEX coupling entries and is not a full uncertainty decomposition.

limitations: The RCX remains an engineering estimate, not foundry-qualified extraction.
The cross-check uses the reduced no-lateral parasitic model; it does not calibrate lateral coupling.
Compact-model ownership and analog LVS views are not a silicon-calibrated VCO model.
The simulated post-layout frequency is not a reverse-inferred silicon parameter.
